prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Charlotte after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Charlotte for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but to give the best, truly local recommendations I need one quick thing: what part of Charlotte are you in (zip code or neighborhood)? That lets me suggest firms that are nearby and take your specific county’s courts/insurance practices into account.

If you want an immediate, general starting point, call Morgan & Morgan (they have offices in North Carolina). Why call them first:
- National firm with many attorneys experienced in car-accident and personal-injury claims
- Contingency-fee model (no fee unless they recover money)
- Usually offer free consultations and initial case evaluation
- Resources to handle larger or more complex claims and to litigate if the insurer won’t settle

Beyond that one call, I recommend contacting several local plaintiff-side personal injury firms so you can compare. If you want, I’ll assemble a short list of 5–8 Charlotte firms to call — but I need your zip code or neighborhood to make the list relevant.

What to ask each firm when you call (short checklist)
- Do you handle car-accident/personal-injury cases in Mecklenburg County?
- How long have you been handling auto-injury cases, and how many similar cases have you handled?
- Who will actually handle my case (name of attorney and whether jury trial experience)?
- Do you take cases on contingency, and what percentage/fees and any out-of-pocket costs I might owe?
- Typical timeline and whether you settle or often go to trial for comparable cases
- How will you communicate updates (phone/text/email) and how often?
- Can you give references or recent client reviews?
- Do you have experience with my insurer or the at-fault driver’s insurance company?

What to have ready before or during the call
- Date/time/location of the crash
- Police report number (if available)
- Names/contact of other drivers, witnesses, and insurers
- Brief summary of injuries and current medical status
- Photos of damage/injuries and any bills or medical records you already have
- Your auto insurance declarations page (if you have UM/UIM questions)

Immediate steps you should take now (if you haven’t already)
- Seek and continue medical care — document everything
- Get the police report and preserve photos/videos of the scene and vehicles
- Do not give recorded statements to insurance adjusters without an attorney (you can provide basic facts)
- Preserve evidence: vehicle repair estimates, medical records, receipts, and contact info for witnesses

If you want, tell me:
- Your Charlotte zip code/neighborhood
- How serious the injuries/damages are
- Whether you prefer a big national firm or a smaller local trial lawyer

I’ll then list 5–8 specific Charlotte-area personal-injury firms to call and a short reason for each one.
